name: icon
title: Icon (primitiva interna)
description: Set de iconos SVG del sistema Scorch, usado por popover, alert, theme-studio y otros módulos.

files.content:

export interface Props {

    | 'monitor'
    | 'search'
    | 'volume-x'
    | 'volume-2'
    | 'sun'
    | 'moon'
    | 'command'
    | 'terminal'
    | 'package'
    | 'zap'
    | 'flame'
    | 'droplet'

  size?: number;
}

const { name, class: className = 'w-3.5 h-3.5 inline-block shrink-0', size = 24 } = Astro.props;
---

  <svg

    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    stroke-width="2"
    stroke-linecap="round"
    stroke-linejoin="round"
    aria-hidden="true"
  >
    <rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2" />

)}
